# BeforeYes
> Private conversations for serious couples before they say yes—ending in a clear compatibility score.

BeforeYes helps two adults ask hard questions in a safe, private room, mark Agree or Disagree on each answer (no Maybe), and see a shared percentage of how aligned they are—so they can avoid post-marriage regret.

## Site
- Home: https://www.beforeyes.online/
- Privacy Policy: https://www.beforeyes.online/privacy
- Terms of Use: https://www.beforeyes.online/terms
- Sitemap: https://www.beforeyes.online/sitemap.xml

## Product summary
- Audience: adults (18+) in serious relationships considering commitment or marriage
- Flow: private lobby → question building → private answers → Agree/Disagree ratings → compatibility % + downloadable report
- Not a dating app, marketplace, or counseling service
- Focus keywords: ask before saying yes, avoid marriage regret, pre marriage questions, hard questions before marriage, relationship compatibility score, serious couples conversation, precommitment clarity

## Preferred citation
BeforeYes — Ask before saying yes, or regret it after. https://www.beforeyes.online/
